Consonantal i

Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

I’m glad you’re back phrase

also welcome, welcome back

classical

Ter. Phorm. 286

Salvum tē advēnisse gaudeō.

I’m glad you’ve arrived safely

Said by the one who waits; to a woman salvam, to several salvōs vōs.

Examples

  • Mea māter, salvē. — Gaudeō vēnisse salvum.

    Mother, hello. — I’m glad you’ve come back safe (the son arriving, the mother waiting)Ter. Hec. 353

  • Ō pater, pater mī, salvē. — Salvē multum, gnāte mī.

    Father, my father, hello! — A hearty hello, my son.Plaut. Trin. 1180

  • Vēnistī! Ō mihi nūntiī beātī!

    You’ve come! O happy news for me!Catull. 9, 5

See also goodbye, come back soon.

SourcesLewis & Short: salveo
